Native iframe focus and input routing

No editor library. The child buttons only focus its editable div and call native Undo or Redo. This fixture isolates browser/runtime behavior.

Tab from the child field should reach the button after the frame. Shift+Tab from the child Undo button should reach the parent field.

The automated history case types in the child, uses its Undo and Redo, fills the parent field, then returns to the child for Ctrl+Z. Input and history must stay with the focused document. See tests/native-frame-focus.js for the exact sequence.
